loops.name: Ads health
loops.description: Check paid spend vs plan. Short card plus a detailed brief with numbers.

loops.name: Inbox watch
loops.description: Scan the inbox during business hours. Post only if someone replied. Brief lists who and what they said.

loops.name: Morning brief
loops.description: Chief of Staff standup: read specialist briefs and write yesterday / today / one ask. Do not invent missing numbers.
loops.prompt: Quote the specialist briefs. If a brief is missing, write no report for that beat.
